d: On September 11, 2001, the world witnessed one of the deadliest terrorist attacks in history. Behind the destruction of the World Trade Center and Twin Towers were thousands of individual stories. This episode of Tarikh explores three unforgettable 9/11 stories: Edna Cintron, the woman seen waving for help from the North Tower; the mysterious man captured in Richard Drew’s Falling Man photograph; and Lauren Grandcolas, a passenger aboard United Airlines Flight 93 who left behind a final phone message for her husband. From the last photographs to the final moments of 9/11 victims, these…
